traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are implemented and verified. The parser now terminates @story/@req values when encountering any non-traceability JSDoc tag line, only continues multi-line values on non-tag lines, recognizes any leading JSDoc tag (@*) as a boundary, and preserves multi-line traceability values without concatenating following JSDoc tags. Comprehensive tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts cover traceability tags before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags as well as the original bug scenario, and all pass in the current Jest run. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md explicitly describes and exemplifies JSDoc coexistence behavior. Existing annotation behavior remains intact, demonstrating backward compatibility. Therefore this story is fully satisfied.
